title: Count Negative Numbers in a Sorted Matrix
summary: In a m x n matrix grid arranged in non-increasing order both row-wise and column-wise, count and return the total number of negative elements.
statement: In a m x n matrix grid arranged in non-increasing order both row-wise and column-wise, count and return the total number of negative elements.
constraints: Rows and columns are sorted nonincreasing.
hints: A negative value means every cell to its right in that row is negative; count them and move up.
A nonnegative value means every cell above it in that column is nonnegative; move right.
Each move discards a fully classified row suffix or column prefix.
editorial: Each move discards a fully classified row suffix or column prefix.

tests.explanation: Zero is not negative, so the answer is zero.
